basic definitions for group types

to define a new group type, it is enough to do type GroupType = object and fill in the relevant overloads, but this design might not be permanent

proc isSubmapping(A, B: typedesc): bool
infers if B is some parent of A depending on eachParent Source   Edit  

Templates

template eachParent[T](group: typedesc[T]; toApply: untyped)

passes each parent type of group is as a call argument to toApply

needs to be overloaded to define group parents, by default assumes no parent types and does nothing

Source   Edit   
template mapping(options: typed) {.pragma.}

sets the mapping options for a field for any mapping group

option can be of any type, which is then interpreted by mapping macros by wrapping it in a hook i.e. toFieldMapping, see the field_options module for the default interpretation

irrelevant options should be ignored by hooks for orthogonality, i.e. a mapping that does not use field names should treat just a name mapping as if no option was given

Source   Edit   
template mapping[T](group: typedesc[T]; options: typed) {.pragma.}
mapping pragma but filtered to the given mapping group, filters with the least inheritance depth or earliest order are preferred Source   Edit
